Thanks, we'll get this moving. I've attached our standard buyer intake template which lists the fields we need to create a vendor record and to map remit instructions to our AP system. For your questions:

- A signed PDF W-9 is acceptable for US entities; for international vendors we typically need equivalent tax residency docs.
- PO format: we accept alphanumeric POs up to 16 characters; for bookkeeping please prefix with the buyer code if you can (e.g., BH-12345).

Next steps:
1) Please have Astra complete the attached Excel with legal name, DBA, EIN/tax ID, entity type, address, remit-to address, and preferred payment method (ACH or wire).
2) If ACH, include bank name, routing number, account number, and a copy of a voided check or bank letter.
3) If wire, include SWIFT/BIC and beneficiary details.
4) Upload W-9 and remit docs to the Drive link below or send back as attachments — don't include sensitive keys in email if possible.

I'll loop Finance (Markus) for wire/ACH verification once we have the form back.

Hi all —

Thanks for the faster-than-expected turnaround, Astra. A couple notes from Finance to make verification and payment processing smooth:

- For ACH we only store the 9-digit ABA routing number and account number in our AP system. Branch suffixes are not required. Please provide the 9-digit ABA.
- Remit-to: please provide the remit processing address (the address payment remittances should be sent to). If invoices are mailed elsewhere, include both but clearly label which is remit processing.
- Please attach one of: voided check, bank letter on bank letterhead, or bank confirmation PDF (the Bank Confirmation you attached looks fine).

I'll perform verification once the completed intake sheet is uploaded. If everything checks, we'll create a vendor ID and share the vendor number + PO prefix sample by end of week.

For reference, here's a minimal set of fields we need to create the vendor and enable ACH:
- Legal entity name
- Tax ID / EIN
- Remit processing address
- Bank name, 9-digit ABA routing number, account number (last four digits masked in email ok)
- W-9 (signed PDF)

I've attached a short wire/ACH instructions template so you can see how we'll store the values. Once verified, Redwood will confirm the vendor ID and your primary payment method.

Regards,
